paper_title: Constraints on axionlike dark matter with masses down to $10^{-23}$ eV/c$^2$
notes: This experiment constrains the axionlike coupling to electrons via the 'axion wind' effect, expressed as F_a/C_e >= 2e15 eV (paper body; abstract says 1e15). The natural output is a limit on C_e/F_a <= 5e-16 eV^-1 over masses 1e-23 to 1e-18 eV. Note the paper's coupling is not the standard dimensionless g_ae but the decay-constant ratio C_e/F_a with units eV^-1; downstream conversion should account for this. The bound is roughly flat over most of the range but weakens near the sidereal bump (~47 zeV) and at highest masses due to attenuation.
